hypothesis: Fixed-budget full-parameter continuation on bilingual natural-language program descriptions and independently executable targets improves held functional code synthesis and both-correct semantic counterfactual pairs over its own frozen L100EC ancestor.
scope: One trained 100M model; frozen ancestor comparison plus semantic counterfactual diagnostic. Combined data recipe, not a causal architecture-ablation study and NOT evidence of Qwen parity.
parent: L100EC curriculum BF16 step1536; verified actual bytes
parent_precision: BF16 upcast FP32, unavailable lost FP32 values not recovered
optimizer: torch Adafactor lr .006, weight_decay0, foreachFalse, clip1
schedule: 32step warmup; fixed cosine to .15 of peak
precision: FP32 weights/grads, BF16 autocast, FP32 delta state
data: 4096 train prompts (2048 unique semantic groups); half English and half Russian; no operator expression or target code in prompt
semantic_group_rule: Function behaviour over all integers -64..64 and empty/singleton lists; covers every possible registered branch breakpoint; group before rendering. New experiment splits mutually disjoint.
ancestor_decontamination: Full EC original training cases unavailable; no guarantee of novel semantics relative to all historical EC data. New named split is not an independent public benchmark.
inference: prompt strings only, unrestricted8192vocab greedy96tokens, no executable solver/retrieval/answer selection, same protocol baseline/final
evaluation: raw output AST allowlist and resource-bounded subprocess execution; all tests including negative/boundary/empty-list cases; no repair or retries; EOS required for pass
ablation: Counterfactual pairs keep literals/condition context and change instruction semantics; score both independently, not only syntax or changed outputs
selection: fixed final1024; validation monitoring only; no held checkpoint tuning
regression: 32 saved ancestor generation probes, descriptive before/after; no new held claim
